description.value: This study investigated neural mechanisms of directed forgetting of negative and neutral words in depressed and healthy participants using fMRI, univariate GLM analysis, and multivoxel pattern classification.

spans.text: In this study, we used the item-method directed forgetting paradigm to explore this phenomenon.
